name: Love Love Navigation ~Koi no Menkyo Koushuu~
original_name: らぶ2・ナビゲーション ～恋の免許講習～
source:
Main character comes to a training camp on the southern island during summer vacation. He meets a variety of lovely girls there. They have fun every day attending classes together and going out to play. But won't study become neglected with so much love in the air?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，主人公来到南方小岛参加集训，并在那里邂逅了形形色色的可爱少女。他们每天一同上课、外出游玩，日子过得欢乐无比。可是，空气中弥漫着如此浓厚的恋爱气息，大家会不会把学习彻底抛到脑后？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
